For \(k=1,\dots,20\), the angle is
\[
\theta_k=\frac{3\pi(k-1)}{2}=2\pi\cdot \frac{3(k-1)}{4}.
\]
Modulo \(2\pi\), the distinct angles depend on \(3(k-1)\pmod 4\). Since \(\gcd(3,4)=1\), \(3(k-1)\) cycles through all four residues \(0,1,2,3\pmod 4\), giving exactly 4 distinct points.

\[
\boxed{4}
\]
